highlights.title: Back up original files too
highlights.description: When moving computers or keeping a copy, back up the database, ebooks, PDFs, and PDF thumbnails together. Restore verifies files and keeps a safety backup; configure API keys again afterward.

highlights.title: Start with your first reading
highlights.description: Import an EPUB, PDF, or web article directly from the first-launch guide, then save a highlight or thought without setting up AI first.

highlights.title: Choose one default model
highlights.description: Use one model for reading, in-depth review, and bilingual translation. Expand per-task settings only when you need different models.

highlights.title: Lighter annotations and imports
highlights.description: Scrolling annotations, changing font size, and loading the library do less repeated work. Ebook parsing runs in the background, and idle local inference releases memory.

highlights.title: Stop requests when you cancel
highlights.description: Canceling a translation aborts its model request. Failed WeRead sync batches also cancel their remaining requests.

highlights.title: See what library questions search
highlights.description: Library questions explicitly search saved highlights, thoughts, discussions you joined, and published distillations—not full documents or unpublished drafts.
